scope: Aggregate article-facing evidence only; no raw logs, source code, task content, identities, paths, or credentials.
readingRule: Each count belongs only to its named test collection and must not be combined as a system-wide success rate.

cases.supports: The named test sets no longer reproduced the advisory-as-block error.
cases.doesNotSupport: System-wide reliability or universal call-time authorization receipts.

cases.supports: Repeated observation did not migrate lifecycle in named paths.
cases.doesNotSupport: Absence of every future bypass path.

cases.supports: Named projections retained tested history after the fix.
cases.doesNotSupport: Lossless propagation of every failure to every surface.

cases.supports: Health, work activity, legal dispatch, and acceptance were separately checked in one recovery case.
cases.doesNotSupport: A physical timestamp alone proves a causal precondition.
